verdict.rationale: AgentMail is API-first: its docs say inboxes can be created, managed and operated entirely via API. It offers an API reference with open-source MIT SDKs, programmatic agent self-signup that needs no console, and a probe confirmed a public OpenAPI spec at docs.agentmail.to/openapi.json. Missing for 10: independent hands-on reports of driving the API end to end (corroboration is limited to probe confirmation of the spec and a community mention of the dashboard's SDK examples).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Create, manage, and operate email inboxes entirely via API.
All of our SDKs are open source and available under the MIT license.
For agents that sign themselves up programmatically, no Console or dashboard needed.
